econ.x: New claims for unemployment benefits in a week, in thousands. They rise early in a downturn (Labor Department, via Nasdaq’s calendar).
How fast the economy grew in the quarter, at an annual rate, after inflation (BEA).
The Federal Reserve’s target range for its benchmark rate is 3.75% to 4.00%; banks lent overnight at 3.88% (New York Fed).
The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate, from Freddie Mac’s weekly survey.
The average 15-year fixed mortgage rate, from Freddie Mac’s weekly survey.
The average price of a gallon of regular gasoline in the U.S. (EIA, weekly).
The average price of a gallon of diesel in the U.S. (EIA, weekly). It feeds into what trucking adds to store prices.
The University of Michigan’s monthly survey of how people feel about the economy. 100 was the level in 1966.
The 10-year Treasury yield minus the 2-year. Below zero has often come before a recession.
